COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_choose_ap_suleyman_demirel_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				original_tag = TUR
				exists = yes
				is_dynamic_country = no
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				is_ai = no
			}
			western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_ap = yes
			NOT = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Süleyman Demirel" ruling_only = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_ap = 29219 }
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_ap_suleyman_demirel = yes
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_leader_party = ruling_party }
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_ap_suleyman_demirel = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				original_tag = TUR
				exists = yes
				is_dynamic_country = no
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			}
			western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_ap = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Süleyman Demirel" ruling_only = yes } } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appointed_slot = 1 } } }
			}
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Süleyman Demirel"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_suleyman_demirel.dds"
				desc = COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_suleyman_demirel_desc
				ideology = conservatism
				traits = { }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appointed_slot = 1 }
		set_correct_ideology_trait = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_ap = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_ap = 29219 }

	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_ap_suleyman_demirel = yes
	}
}

		else_if = {
			limit = {

			limit = {
				date > 1995.9.9
			}

		}
		else_if = {

		}

		}
	}

COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_anap_turgut_ozal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				original_tag = TUR
				exists = yes
				is_dynamic_country = no
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			}
			neutrality_neutral_libertarians_are_in_power = yes
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_anap = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Turgut Özal" ruling_only = yes } } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appointed_slot = 16 } } }
			}
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Turgut Özal"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_turgut_ozal.dds"
				desc = COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_turgut_ozal_desc
				ideology = Neutral_Libertarian
				traits = { }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appointed_slot = 16 }
		set_correct_ideology_trait = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_anap = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_anap = 34495 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_anap_turgut_ozal = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_anap = 38968 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_anap_yildirim_akbulut = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_anap = 25656 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_anap_mesut_yilmaz = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1991.6.15
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_anap_mesut_yilmaz = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1989.10.31
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_anap_yildirim_akbulut = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_anap_turgut_ozal = yes
		}
	}
}

		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_mhp_restored = 2134 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_mhp_restored_devlet_bahceli = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_mhp_restored_alparslan_turkes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_military = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_military = 35615 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_memduh_tagmac = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_military = 63744 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_faruk_gurler = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_military = 23017 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_semih_sancar = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_military = 48631 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_kenan_evren = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_military = 8667 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_turgut_sunalp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_preference_military = 39888 }
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_bulend_ulusu = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1978.3.7
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_kenan_evren = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1973.3.6
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_semih_sancar = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1972.8.29
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_faruk_gurler = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_appoint_military_memduh_tagmac = yes
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = TUR
			exists = yes
			is_dynamic_country = no
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 6 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 13 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 14 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 16 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 20 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 } }
		}
		update_set_politics = yes
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_politics_init = yes
		COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_migrate = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_ap = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_ap = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_dyp = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_dyp = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				western_liberals_are_in_power = yes
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_ytp = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_ytp = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_chp = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_chp = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_sodep = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_sodep = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_hp = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_hp = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_shp = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_shp = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes

			}

		}

				emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes

			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_tkp = yes
		}

				emerging_reactionaries_are_in_power = yes

			}

		}

				emerging_reactionaries_are_in_power = yes

		}

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				nationalist_military_junta_are_in_power = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_resolve_military = yes
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_leader_party = ruling_party }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_initialized
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_programmes = yes
		}
	}
}
